<translate>
<!--T:7-->
'''Vegeta''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who waits at [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta's Saiyan Pod|Vegeta's Saiyan Pod]] in the rocky lands of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. He teaches his signature ki attacks, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fake Moon|Fake Moon]] and two strikes, and runs the '''Gravity''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|training minigame]]. He trains anyone, whatever their alignment.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location == <!--T:8-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:9-->
Vegeta waits at [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta's Saiyan Pod|Vegeta's Saiyan Pod]], which generates once per world in rocky biomes. Bulma is there too. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 5 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegeta's Saiyan Pod#Finding it|Vegeta's Saiyan Pod]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques == <!--T:10-->
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:11-->
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], Defense Penetration, [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]]
* '''Ki attacks:''' Galick Gun, Big Bang Attack, Final Flash, Final Explosion, [[Special:MyLanguage/Fake Moon|Fake Moon]]
* '''Strike attacks:''' Deadly Dance (Vegetto), Spirit Breaking Cannon
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:12-->
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill.
</translate>

<translate>
== Training == <!--T:13-->
</translate>
{{Main|Training Minigames}}
<translate>
<!--T:14-->
Vegeta's '''Train''' option offers a Shadow Clone to spar with and the '''Gravity''' minigame: pilot a Saiyan pod through a canyon of rock pillars. Play it from Vegeta 3 times reaching level 5 to learn it; after that you can replay it from the Minigames tab of your menu, and starting it from Vegeta pays a +25% mentor bonus.
</translate>

<translate>
== As a tournament fighter == <!--T:16-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:17-->
Vegeta also fights in two [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|tournaments]], as NPC fighters separate from the master:
* '''Vegeta (Mid)''' and '''Vegeta (Mid, Super Saiyan)''' can be drawn as contenders in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]]. A bracket has at most one of them.
* '''Vegeta (End)''', in his base, Super Saiyan or Super Saiyan 2 form, can be drawn as a contender in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]], at most one per bracket. '''Majin Vegeta''' counts as a different character, so he can be drawn in the same bracket.
* His fusions with [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] fight in the Otherworld Tournament too: [[Special:MyLanguage/Gogeta|Gogeta]] (by the Fusion Dance) is its champion, and [[Special:MyLanguage/Vegetto|Vegetto]] (by the Potara Earrings) can be drawn as a contender.
</translate>
